issues.title: GS Breaks Ground on AI Data Center in Donghae, Gangwon, With President Lee in Attendance
issues.titleKo: 강원 동해에서 GS AI 데이터센터 착공, 이재명 대통령도 착공식 참석
issues.summary: GS Group on the 28th began the first phase of a 1.2GW AI data center in Donghae, Gangwon Province. President Lee Jae Myung attended the groundbreaking ceremony and said the government would mobilize all its capabilities in the AI race.
issues.why: Local youth hiring and university-linked courses are being pursued together, which is useful for college students thinking about careers in AI infrastructure.

paragraphs.en: GS Group held a groundbreaking ceremony for an AI data center on the 28th at the Bukpyeong Second General Industrial Complex in Donghae, Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province. More than 270 people attended, including President Lee Jae Myung, GS Group Chairman Huh Tae-soo, Gangwon Gov. Woo Sang-ho and Deputy Prime Minister and Science Minister Bae Kyung-hoon. It is the first case among the government's announced mega projects in which a gigawatt-class AI data center has actually started construction.
paragraphs.ko: GS그룹은 28일 강원특별자치도 동해시 북평제2일반산업단지에서 AI 데이터센터 착공식을 열었다. 이재명 대통령, 허태수 GS그룹 회장, 우상호 강원도지사, 배경훈 부총리 겸 과학기술정보통신부 장관 등 270여 명이 참석했다. 정부가 발표한 메가프로젝트 가운데 기가와트급 AI 데이터센터가 실제로 첫 공사에 들어간 사례다.

sents.en: GS Group held a groundbreaking ceremony for an AI data center on the 28th at the Bukpyeong Second General Industrial Complex in Donghae, Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province.

paragraphs.en: The groundbreaking covers the first phase of the plan GS unveiled at a government public report meeting in June, which totals 2.4GW and up to 120 trillion won. The first phase is 1.2GW, and construction begins with a 100MW-class facility. GS aims to complete it in stages from 2028, with the first phase finished and fully operating in 2029. The company reportedly chose the site because of the east coast's abundant power generation and the possibility of adopting seawater cooling.

paragraphs.en: After signing a business agreement with GS and Donghae City in July, Gangwon Province supported licensing procedures such as a power grid impact assessment and building permits. GS plans to hire a certain share of its construction and operating workers from local residents. It also plans to pursue specialized data center courses with universities in the province, including Kangwon National University, Hallym University and Catholic Kwandong University, so that they lead to jobs for local young people. The province projects that direct and indirect operating staff will number from several hundred to about 1,000 after completion.
paragraphs.ko: 강원도는 지난 7월 GS, 동해시와 업무협약을 맺은 뒤 전력계통영향평가와 건축허가 같은 인허가 절차를 지원했다. GS는 건설 인력과 운영 인력 가운데 일정 비율을 지역 주민으로 채용할 계획이다. 강원대, 한림대, 가톨릭관동대 등 도내 대학과 연계해 데이터센터 전문 교육과정도 추진해 지역 청년의 취업으로 이어지게 한다는 구상이다. 강원도는 준공 뒤 직간접 운영 인력이 수백 명에서 1천여 명에 이를 것으로 내다봤다.

paragraphs.en: In his congratulatory speech, Lee said the world is competing at the national level through AI technology and that the government would mobilize all its capabilities. He also said the Gangwon AI data center would be a catalyst for preemptive investment by global companies. Huh said he would do his best to make Donghae a landmark that people visit to see the future of the AI industry. After the event, the president also toured data center cooling technologies from Korean companies including LS Electric, LG Electronics and SDT.
paragraphs.ko: 이 대통령은 축사에서 세계가 AI 기술로 국가 단위의 경쟁을 벌이고 있다며, 정부가 모든 역량을 동원하겠다고 말했다. 또 강원 AI 데이터센터가 글로벌 기업의 선제적 투자를 이끄는 마중물이 될 것이라고 했다. 허태수 회장은 동해가 AI 산업의 미래를 보러 오는 명소가 되도록 최선을 다하겠다고 밝혔다. 대통령은 행사 뒤 LS일렉트릭, LG전자, SDT 등 국내 기업의 데이터센터 냉각 관련 기술도 둘러봤다.

paragraphs.en: The government has completed the advance notice of legislation for the subordinate regulations of the special act on promoting the AI data center industry, which takes effect in March next year. The regulations set the exemption range from the power grid impact assessment for data centers outside the capital region at 50MW and lay the basis for designating AI data center special zones. Gangwon Province plans to attract more data centers to Chuncheon, Wonju, Gangneung and Samcheok, using Donghae as a model.
paragraphs.ko: 정부는 내년 3월 시행되는 AI 데이터센터 산업 진흥 특별법의 하위법령 입법예고를 마쳤다. 비수도권 데이터센터의 전력계통영향평가 면제 범위를 50MW로 정하고 AI 데이터센터 특구 지정 근거를 마련하는 내용이다. 강원도는 동해를 모델로 춘천, 원주, 강릉, 삼척 등에도 데이터센터를 더 유치하겠다는 계획이다.

issues.titleKo: AI 커닝 막자, 대학 논술장에 금속탐지기와 일회용 가운 등장
issues.summary: At essay exams at Pusan National University and Kyungpook National University on the 28th, metal detector checks, disposable gowns and button stickers were used to prevent cheating with AI devices. Stronger measures, including radio-wave detectors, were also applied for the first time at national health care licensing exams the same day.
issues.why: College students preparing for early-admission essay exams or licensing tests should check banned items and dress rules in advance to avoid penalties.

paragraphs.en: On the 28th, Pusan National University and Kyungpook National University held essay exams for the 2027 academic year's early admissions round. They enforced tight security measures to prevent cheating with artificial intelligence (AI). The same day, the Ministry of Health and Welfare applied strengthened measures against cheating for the first time to national exams for health care professionals.
paragraphs.ko: 28일 부산대학교와 경북대학교가 2027학년도 수시모집 논술고사를 치렀다. 두 대학은 인공지능(AI)을 이용한 부정행위를 막기 위해 강도 높은 보안 조치를 시행했다. 같은 날 보건복지부는 보건의료인 국가시험에도 강화된 부정행위 관리 대책을 처음으로 적용했다.

paragraphs.en: A total of 10,291 students applied for Pusan National University's essay exam, including 6,078 in natural sciences and 4,213 in humanities and social sciences. Examinees could not bring any electronic devices, including mobile phones and smart glasses. They also could not wear accessories such as necklaces, clothes with buttons or zippers, hats or hoodies. On entering the exam rooms, they had their belongings checked with metal detectors and put on disposable gowns handed out by the school. Belongings left in the hallway underwent a separate radio-wave detection check, and restrooms were inspected before and after the exam.
paragraphs.ko: 부산대 논술에는 자연 계열 6천78명, 인문·사회 계열 4천213명 등 모두 1만291명이 지원했다. 수험생은 휴대전화와 스마트 안경 등 모든 전자 기기를 가져갈 수 없었다. 목걸이 같은 장신구와 단추·지퍼가 달린 옷, 모자, 후드티도 입을 수 없었다. 고사실에 들어갈 때는 금속탐지기로 소지품을 검사받고 학교가 나눠 준 일회용 가운을 입었다. 복도에 둔 소지품은 별도의 전파 탐지 검사를 받았고, 시험 전후로 화장실도 점검했다.

paragraphs.en: Kyungpook National University's essay exam (AAT) drew 11,301 applicants for 550 spots, a competition ratio of 20.55 to 1. The university ran metal detector checks on all examinees, had them attach stickers to clothing buttons, and handed out ballpoint pens, mechanical pencils and erasers all at once on site. The university explained that licensing exam management has been put on alert after this year's top passer of the certified tax accountant exam admitted to cheating with an AI smart device. Examinees found with banned devices or refusing inspection will be treated as cheaters and have the exam invalidated.
paragraphs.ko: 경북대 논술(AAT)은 550명 모집에 1만1천301명이 지원해 경쟁률이 20.55대 1이었다. 경북대는 모든 수험생에게 금속탐지기 검사를 하고, 옷 단추에는 스티커를 붙이게 했으며, 볼펜과 샤프, 지우개는 현장에서 한꺼번에 나눠 줬다. 대학 측은 올해 세무사 시험 수석 합격자가 AI 스마트 기기를 이용한 부정행위를 시인한 일로 자격시험 관리에 비상이 걸렸다고 설명했다. 금지 기기를 갖고 있다가 적발되거나 검사에 응하지 않으면 부정행위로 보고 해당 고사를 무효로 처리하기로 했다.

issues.summary: POSCO's labor and management finalized this year's wage talks on the 28th after a vote of all union members approved the tentative agreement. The deal passed with 65.01% in favor and includes a 2.6% base pay increase and incentive payments.

The POSCO Labor Union, the main bargaining union and an affiliate of the Korean Metal Workers' Federation of the Federation of Korean Trade Unions, put the tentative agreement to a vote of all its members on the 28th. A majority voted in favor, and the deal passed.

issues.title: Cheaper Than Korea: Mounjaro Buying Trips to Japan's Tsushima Island Surge
issues.titleKo: 한국보다 싸다며 대마도로 향하는 마운자로 구매 원정이 늘었다
issues.summary: Since the government allowed obesity drugs prescribed overseas to be brought into Korea, the number of Koreans traveling to Japan's Tsushima Island to buy Mounjaro has risen sharply. In Japan, the drug is managed at a national health insurance price, so it costs far less than in Korea.
issues.why: College students who want to use obesity drugs would do well to know why prices differ and what time and money overseas purchases involve.

paragraphs.en: Since the 12th, when the government began allowing obesity drugs formally prescribed overseas to be brought into Korea, the number of Koreans heading to Japan's Tsushima Island (Daemado) to buy Mounjaro has surged. The trend of traveling to cheaper Japan has even produced a coinage, "sushijaro," a blend of sushi and Mounjaro.
paragraphs.ko: 정부가 지난 12일부터 해외에서 정식 처방받은 비만치료제를 국내로 가져오는 것을 허용한 뒤, 일본 쓰시마섬(대마도)으로 마운자로를 사러 가는 한국인이 급증하고 있다. 값이 싼 일본으로 원정을 가는 흐름을 두고 '스시자로(스시와 마운자로)'라는 말까지 생겼다.

issues.title: Police Arrest 52 Including Clinic Heads Over 8,400 Fake Plastic Surgery Reviews Posted Through Hacked Accounts
issues.titleKo: 해킹 계정으로 성형 후기 8400건 조작, 병원장 등 52명 검거
issues.summary: The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency arrested 52 people, including officials at plastic surgery clinics and advertising firms, who fabricated surgery reviews using hacked portal accounts. President Lee Jae Myung said on X on the 28th that he would respond sternly to such crimes.
issues.why: Many college students choose clinics based on surgery reviews, and this case shows that fake reviews staged to look as if real patients wrote them may exist.

paragraphs.en: President Lee Jae Myung said on X on the morning of the 28th that he would respond sternly to the plastic surgery review manipulation case, sharing a news report on the police investigation. He said he was appalled that hacked accounts were bought and reviews were staged to look as if real patients had written them. He also called it a serious illegal act that exploited personal information to deceive the public and make unjust profits.
paragraphs.ko: 이재명 대통령은 28일 오전 엑스(X)에 경찰 수사 결과를 다룬 보도를 공유하며 성형 후기 조작 사건에 엄정하게 대응하겠다고 밝혔다. 대통령은 해킹된 계정을 사서 실제 환자처럼 후기를 꾸몄다는 점에 기가 막힌다고 했다. 또 개인정보를 악용해 국민을 속이고 부당한 이익을 챙긴 중대한 불법행위라고 지적했다.

paragraphs.en: The cyber investigation unit of the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency said it arrested 52 people, including officials at four plastic surgery clinics and three advertising firms and members of an account-selling ring. They face charges of violating the Information and Communications Network Act, obstruction of business involving computers and violating the Medical Service Act. Two members of the account-selling ring were referred to prosecutors in custody. They are suspected of buying about 800 domestic portal accounts from August 2021 to July this year and posting more than 8,400 false reviews and comments on plastic surgery cafes and beauty and medical information platforms.

paragraphs.en: Their methods were also revealed. Clinics entrusted fake reviews to advertising agencies, and some even set up their own advertising firms with dozens of employees. issues.summary: As the school-age population shrinks, hiring of elementary teachers is also shrinking, and education college students and prospective teachers are rethinking their careers. The Ministry of Education said that even if it cuts the number of hires, it planned for the year-to-year change not to be large.
issues.why: This is not only a story for education and teachers college students; those in other majors whose job prospects are affected by the falling school-age population cannot treat it as someone else's problem.

paragraphs.en: The Hankyoreh reported that as the low birth rate shrinks the school-age population and teacher hiring is cut, more prospective elementary teachers are turning to other careers or working as fixed-term teachers while preparing to retake the appointment exam. Jung, 27, who graduated from Gyeongin National University of Education, said that despite considering other jobs, it was hard to explore other fields because a university of education is a special-purpose university. Two years after graduating, Jung is working as a fixed-term teacher at an elementary school in Incheon while preparing for the appointment exam.
paragraphs.ko: 저출생으로 학령인구가 줄면서 교사 임용 규모가 축소되자, 다른 진로로 눈을 돌리거나 기간제 교사로 일하며 임용시험을 다시 준비하는 예비 초등교사가 늘고 있다고 한겨레가 전했다. 경인교대를 졸업한 정 모(27) 씨는 다른 직업을 생각해 봤지만 교대가 특수목적 대학이라 다른 직종을 알아보기 어려웠다고 한다. 결국 졸업 2년 만에 인천의 한 초등학교에서 기간제 교사로 일하며 임용시험을 준비하고 있다.

paragraphs.en: Lee, 23, who took a leave of absence from the elementary education department of a comprehensive university, is looking for a job at an education-related foundation instead of taking the exam. Lee said that the low birth rate and the crisis in teachers' authority, represented by the Seoi Elementary School case, have led more people to look for careers other than teaching. Lee also said many people re-sit the college entrance exam while enrolled to get into medical, dental or Korean medicine schools, or prepare for the Law School Admission Test (LEET) or the Grade 5 civil service exam. Kang, 26, who graduated from Seoul National University of Education, said that even though the school selects about 300 students every year, elementary teacher hiring in Seoul stays in the low hundreds annually.

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Education announced a mid- to long-term teacher supply plan that gradually reduces new public elementary and secondary school teachers over the next five years. In September, the ministry set next year's elementary teacher hiring at 2,821, which is 292 fewer than this year. The main test-takers for the 2027 academic-year exam are those with student numbers 21 to 23, and hiring was 3,864, 3,455 and 3,561, respectively, when they entered university. Compared with those figures, next year's hiring is down by nearly 1,000.
paragraphs.ko: 교육부는 향후 5년간 공립 초·중등학교 신규 교사 수를 단계적으로 줄이는 중장기 교원 수급 방향을 발표했다. 신규 초등교사는 2027년 2700~2900명, 2028년 2600~2900명, 2029년과 2030년에는 각각 2500~2800명 수준으로 줄어든다. 지난 9월에는 내년 초등교사 임용 인원을 올해보다 292명 적은 2821명으로 확정했다. 2027학년도 임용시험의 주 응시층인 21~23학번이 입학할 때의 채용 규모는 각각 3864명, 3455명, 3561명이었다. 이와 비교하면 1000명 가까이 줄었다.

paragraphs.en: Concern is also growing that fixed-term teacher jobs could shrink. In August, the ministry unveiled a reform that scraps the system linking local education grants to domestic tax revenue after 55 years and instead reflects nominal growth and changes in the school-age population. The concern arises because the grants are the source of funds for fixed-term teachers' pay. Prospective and current teachers argue that the decline in the school-age population should not be tied directly to cutting teachers, and should instead be used as a chance to reduce class sizes and teaching hours per teacher. issues.summary: Choi Min-jeong won the women's 1,000m final at the fourth World Tour event in Shanghai on the 28th with a time of 1:30.981. It is her fourth straight gold in the event to open the season, and Kim Gil-li took bronze.
issues.why: This is the final season of a leading athlete who will give up her national team emblem after this season, which should catch the eye of college students interested in sports.

paragraphs.en: Short track national team member Choi Min-jeong (Seongnam City Hall) won gold in the women's 1,000m at the fourth leg of the 2026-2027 ISU Short Track World Tour at the Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai, China, on the 28th. Her final time of 1:30.981 beat runner-up Xandra Velzeboer of the Netherlands (1:31.115) by 0.134 seconds.
paragraphs.ko: 쇼트트랙 국가대표 최민정(성남시청)이 28일 중국 상하이 오리엔탈 스포츠센터에서 열린 2026-2027 ISU 쇼트트랙 월드투어 4차 대회 여자 1,000m에서 금메달을 땄다. 결승 기록은 1분30초981로, 2위 산드라 펠제부르(네덜란드, 1분31초115)를 0.134초 차로 앞섰다.

issues.title: Rally at Seoul's Bosingak Demands Rape Law Be Rewritten Around Consent
issues.titleKo: 서울 보신각 앞 집회, 동의 여부 중심으로 강간죄 요건 개정 요구
issues.summary: Women's groups and others rallied in front of Bosingak in Seoul's Jongno District on the 28th, demanding that the legal definition of rape focus on the victim's consent rather than on assault or intimidation. The articles carry no opposing view or official position from the government or the National Assembly.
issues.why: Debate over how sexual violence is judged bears directly on college students' everyday safety and their understanding of the law.

paragraphs.en: On the 28th at 1 p.m., women's groups and civil society organizations held a rally in front of Bosingak in Jongno District, Seoul, calling for an amendment to the rape law. Yonhap News Agency reported that the Korean Womenworkers Association, the Korea Sexual Violence Relief Center and the Korea Women's Associations United took part. The Hankyoreh reported that the Joint Committee for Amending the Rape Law and Lawyers for a Democratic Society held the event, titled “2026 March to End Violence Against Women: Agree to Amend the Rape Law.” The event was held to mark the World Week to Eliminate Violence Against Women. About 600 participants chanted slogans such as “No consent means rape” and marched from Bosingak toward Gwanghwamun before returning to Bosingak.
paragraphs.ko: 28일 오후 1시 서울 종로구 보신각 앞에서 여성단체와 시민사회단체가 강간죄 개정을 요구하는 집회를 열었다. 연합뉴스는 한국여성노동자회, 한국성폭력상담소, 한국여성단체연합 등이 참여했다고 전했다. 한겨레는 강간죄개정을위한연대회의와 민주사회를 위한 변호사모임 등이 ‘2026 여성폭력추방행진–강간죄 개정에 동의하라’ 행사를 열었다고 보도했다. 행사는 세계 여성폭력 추방주간을 맞아 열렸다. 참가자 600여 명은 ‘동의 없으면 강간이다’ 등의 구호를 외치며 보신각에서 광화문 방향으로 행진한 뒤 보신각으로 돌아왔다.

paragraphs.en: At issue are the conditions under which rape is established. The organizers argued that because the current Criminal Act requires “assault or intimidation,” an act is recognized as rape only when the victim resisted a physical threat. They said the elements of the crime should therefore be changed to turn on whether the victim consented. Critics also said perpetrators often use coercion or deception instead of assault or intimidation, yet the law examines only whether the victim resisted, shifting responsibility onto the victim.
paragraphs.ko: 쟁점은 강간죄가 성립하는 조건이다. 집회 측은 현행 형법이 ‘폭행 또는 협박’을 요건으로 하기 때문에 피해자가 물리적 위협에 맞서 저항한 경우에야 강간으로 인정된다고 주장했다. 그래서 피해자의 동의 여부를 기준으로 삼도록 구성 요건을 고쳐야 한다고 했다. 가해자가 폭행·협박 대신 강요나 속임수를 쓰는 일도 많은데, 법이 피해자의 저항 여부만 따져 책임을 피해자에게 돌린다는 비판도 나왔다.

The first is to change the requirement for rape from “assault or intimidation” to “sexual consent.” The second is a full overhaul of the Domestic Violence Punishment Act so that it covers violence in intimate relationships. The third is to remove the provision punishing women in prostitution from the Act on the Punishment of Prostitution and to strengthen the responsibility of those who buy, broker or exploit sex. issues.summary: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party's population strategy headquarters has proposed considering raising the definition of elderly from the current 65 and over to 70 or 75. The aim is to secure labor, but the change could stir controversy because it would affect social security such as pensions.
issues.why: Aging and labor shortages are problems South Korea also faces, so Japan's debate offers a reference point for when today's college students will work and receive pensions.

paragraphs.en: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party has put forward a proposal to consider raising the standard for who counts as elderly above the current “65 and over.” The aim is to secure workers as the population shrinks.
paragraphs.ko: 일본 집권 자민당이 고령자의 기준을 지금의 ‘65세 이상’보다 높이는 방안을 검토하자는 제언을 내놨다. 인구가 줄어드는 상황에서 일할 사람을 확보하려는 취지다.

The proposal rests on the view that a falling population is unavoidable for the time being, even if the decline in the birth rate is slowed. It says the economy and society must therefore be reshaped to cope with many challenges.

issues.summary: Seoul's Seodaemun District held a housing forum on the 26th with six young people at a youth housing complex in Changcheon-dong. The participants named a lack of contract information and the burdens of rent, interest on deposit loans and maintenance fees as their biggest difficulties.
issues.why: It tells college students planning to live on their own to look closely at the contract process and at maintenance fees on top of rent.

paragraphs.en: Seoul's Seodaemun District held a “Youth Log-in” forum on the 26th in the community room of a youth housing complex in Changcheon-dong. They discussed housing problems with Seodaemun District head Park Un-gi and Lee Jeong-mi, chief executive of LH Housing Welfare Information.

issues.titleKo: 연세대, 8년간 1300억 원 들여 ‘사람 중심 AI 캠퍼스’ 비전 선포
issues.summary: Yonsei University held a ceremony on the 27th at its Sinchon Campus to announce a human-centered AI campus vision and said it would invest at least 130 billion won over eight years starting in 2026. Starting with the 2028 academic year, all incoming students will be required to take an AI-related liberal arts course.
issues.why: Making AI a required liberal arts subject and expanding the AI convergence major could affect course choices for current students and prospective freshmen.

paragraphs.en: Yonsei University held a “Human-Centered AI Campus Vision Declaration Ceremony” on the morning of the 27th in the Baekyang Nuri Grand Ballroom at its Sinchon Campus. As AI changes how knowledge is delivered and assessed, the event set out the direction and plans for an AI transition across education, research and administration.
paragraphs.ko: 연세대학교가 27일 오전 신촌캠퍼스 백양누리 그랜드볼룸에서 ‘사람 중심 AI 캠퍼스 비전 선포식’을 열었다. AI 발전으로 지식 전달과 평가 방식이 달라지는 가운데 교육·연구·행정 전반의 AI 전환 방향과 계획을 내놓는 자리였다.

paragraphs.en: President Yoon Dong-sub declared “Truth That Sets Free, Intellect That Serves” as the campus's new vision for the AI era. The idea is to raise people who do not simply accept the answers AI gives but ask questions and verify them for themselves. Yonsei plans to invest at least 130 billion won over eight years from 2026 for this purpose.
paragraphs.ko: 윤동섭 총장은 ‘자유케 하는 진리, 섬기는 지성’을 AI 시대의 새 캠퍼스 비전으로 선포했다. AI가 준 답을 그대로 받아들이지 않고 스스로 질문하고 검증하는 인재를 기르겠다는 구상이다. 연세대는 이를 위해 2026년부터 8년간 1300억 원 이상을 투입할 예정이다.
